items.q: Who is Mike Johnson on the Logan City Council?
items.a: Mike Johnson is a member of the Logan Municipal Council in Logan, Utah. He was elected in 2023, served as Vice Chair in 2025 and as Council Chair in 2026. He owns Mike Johnson Photo + Video, a commercial photo and video company in Logan, and is running for re-election in 2027.

items.q: What does Mike Johnson stand for?
items.a: Attainable housing, fiscal responsibility, safer streets for driving, walking and biking, parks and trails (including the Logan Greenway and a new recreation center), quality local jobs, and long-term planning such as the Logan 2045 General Plan.

items.q: How do I contact Mike Johnson about a city issue?
items.a: For city business, email mike.johnson@loganutah.gov. For the campaign, email MikeForLogan@gmail.com or call or text 435-764-4241.

items.q: When does the Logan Municipal Council meet?
items.a: Regular council meetings are on the first and third Tuesdays of each month at 5:30 p.m. at Logan City Hall, 290 North 100 West. Meetings are streamed on the City of Logan YouTube channel, and anyone can comment on non-agenda items.

items.q: How can I help Mike's campaign?
items.a: Put up a yard sign, hand out door hangers, write a letter of support, host a neighborhood meet and greet, or donate. Sign up on the Get Involved page.

items.q: How do I register to vote in Logan, Utah?
items.a: Register or check your registration at vote.utah.gov. Logan City Council elections are held in odd-numbered years.
